integrity: A formal proof establishes the all-parameter formula; a standalone finite checker validates four small prime-field configurations. Independent mathematical review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact type distribution only for products of dual-number rings with common residue field and square-zero radical; it does not classify embedded subalgebras, higher nilpotency length, mixed residue fields, or noncommutative algebras.
title: Exact type law for subalgebras generated in a product of dual-number rings
